claims.quote: Texas State University researchers are paving the way for smarter highway maintenance across Texas’ 703,000 lane miles of highways. With continued Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) funding, a cross-disciplinary team led by Feng Wang, Ph.D., professor in the Ingram School of Engineering, and Jelena Tešić, Ph.D., associate professor of computer science, is developing an artificial intelligence (AI) system to detect road damage more accurately.
